description: A safer AI workflow for CSV cleanup: normalize headers, trim whitespace, standardize known fields, flag duplicates, and produce a validation summary before export. Use non-sensitive data and verify important changes before importing into another system. #automation #excel #csv #chatgpt

captions.text: Stop cleaning messy CSV files cell by cell.
Upload a non-sensitive CSV and give precise cleanup rules.
Normalize headers, trim spaces, standardize email casing.
Flag duplicates — don’t delete them yet.
Then ask for a validation summary.
Rows in. Duplicates flagged. Missing values. Columns changed.
Good automation should explain what changed.
Review a few rows, then export.
Faster than manual cleanup — and easier to repeat.
